characters.name: 面馆老板
characters.design: Middle-aged Asian male noodle shop owner, wearing a plain white cotton apron with faint flour stains, short black hair, warm weathered face, hands lightly dusted with flour. Close-up shot focuses on his hands kneading dough, natural soft morning light from the side window highlighting skin texture and floating flour particles.

characters.name: 第一位客人
characters.design: Young Asian male guest seated by the sunlit window, wearing a light casual jacket, relaxed posture, holding chopsticks ready. Soft golden morning light illuminates his face with a warm peaceful expression, medium shot to capture his interaction with the served hot noodle bowl.

props.name: 手工面团
props.design: Smooth pale beige wheat dough resting on a floured dark wooden countertop, soft elastic texture with a light dusting of flour on surface. Overhead close-up shot shows the smooth surface and faint indent marks from kneading, warm side light highlighting the dough's matte natural texture.

props.name: 沸水煮面锅
props.design: Large stainless steel pot filled with rolling boiling water, bright metallic surface with faint water usage stains, steam curling steadily upward from the water surface. Side angle shot shows boiling water bubbles and rising steam, warm morning light reflecting softly off the metal surface.

props.name: 热汤面碗
props.design: White ceramic bowl filled with steaming hot noodles topped with fresh green scallions and red chili oil, thick steam rising from the bowl surface. Side close-up shot captures the curling steam and vibrant topping colors, warm golden light hitting the steam to create a hazy warm effect.

scenes.name: 清晨面馆后厨操作区
scenes.design: Compact traditional Chinese noodle shop kitchen at dawn, dark wooden countertop dusted with flour, stainless steel cooking equipment placed neatly, soft golden diffused morning light seeping through the small kitchen window, faint steam floating in the air, warm cozy textured documentary-style atmosphere, medium wide shot to show the full operation area.

scenes.name: 靠窗客人餐位
scenes.design: Sunlit windowsill seating area of the noodle shop, simple solid wood table and stool, soft bright morning light pouring through the window, warm golden glow covering the table surface, faint steam from the placed noodle bowl, cozy peaceful slice-of-life morning atmosphere, medium shot to show the space around the window.
